title: Sea Change
summary:
Non-investment-grade bonds, those rated double B and below,
were off limits to fiduciaries since proper financial behavior mandated the avoidance of risk. But in the mid-1970s, Michael Milken, and a few others have the idea that it should be possible to issue
non-investment-grade bonds and to invest in them prudently if the bonds offered enough
interest in these securities, the bonds of perhaps America's riskiest public companies, and I was
making money steadily and safely.
